stem: ![](asset:P000538-stem-1)A block of mass 0.6 kg is pressed against a vertical wall by a force of 10 N acting perpendicular to the surface. A horizontal force of 8 N is acting on the block. Find the acceleration of the block if the coefficient of friction between the block and the wall is 0.25.

assets.alt: A 0.6 kg block on a vertical wall, pressed into it by a 10 N force, with an 8 N force acting along the wall.
View facing the wall (the 10 N press is into the page): a 0.6 kg block with an 8 N force to the right and its 6 N weight down; friction f = μN = 2.5 N acts up and to the left.
